mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workplace_file_rule VALUES (#{scopeKey}, #{logicalPath}, #{inclusionMode}) ON CONFLICT(scope_key, logical_path) DO UPDATE SET inclusion_mode = excluded.inclusion_mode
INSERT INTO workplace_file_rule VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(scope_key, logical_path) DO UPDATE SET inclusion_mode = excluded.inclusion_mode
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workplace_file_rule WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND (logical_path = #{path} OR logical_path LIKE #{childPattern} ESCAPE '\\')
mapper.update: UPDATE workplace_file_rule SET logical_path = CASE WHEN logical_path = #{oldBase} THEN #{newBase} ELSE #{newBase} || substr(logical_path, length(#{oldBase}) + 1) END WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND (logical_path = #{oldBase} OR logical_path LIKE #{childPattern} ESCAPE '\\')
